proposals.evidence: Turner *ṭōkk explicitly includes Nepali ṭoknu snap at/bite and Kumauni ṭokṇo. These Nepalese survey forms match that regional verb, with ordinary finite endings; negative clauses and other kɔp-/kam- biting verbs are not included.
